title: Inflachromene Blocks Neuronal HMGB1 Translocation to Mitigate Hippocampal TLR4-NF-kappaB-Mediated Neuroinflammation and Depression-Like Behavior After Spinal Cord Injury.
authors: Zhou, Wu; Hei, Bo; Liu, Zhixin; Wang, Zhihua; Li, Chengcai; Ding, Zihan; Li, Meihua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究脊髓损伤后抑郁模型中HMGB1核转位及TLR4-NF-kB通路，虽涉及分子对接但核心为神经炎症机制与药物疗效，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Growing evidence suggests that spinal cord injury (SCI) can result in chronic brain damage, potentially leading to depression and cognitive deficits. High mobility group box-1 (HMGB1) plays a pivotal role in the pathogenesis of central nervous system (CNS) disorders, yet the mechanism by which SCI induces depression remains unclear. This study aims to explore the key mechanisms by which HMGB1 contributes to depression-like behaviors following SCI. A rat model of SCI-induced depression was established to assess the therapeutic effects of ICM on neurobehavioral outcomes, microglial activation, and neuronal damage. Molecular docking was performed to predict the interaction between ICM and HMGB1. Hippocampal RNA-seq profiled ICM-responsive transcriptional changes, with DEGs identified and KEGG enrichment highlighting TLR4-NF-kappaB signaling, followed by Western blot validation of selected targets. In vivo, immunofluorescence, Western blotting, qRT-PCR, and ELISA were utilized to evaluate HMGB1 translocation, TLR4-NF-kappaB pathway activation, and inflammatory cytokine production in the hippocampus. In vitro, a microglia-neuron co-culture system was used to investigate the role of neuronal HMGB1 in microglia-mediated neuroinflammation, with suppression of HMGB1 achieved via ICM pretreatment or siRNA knockdown. Our findings showed that inflachromene (ICM) effectively suppressed microglial activation, thereby reducing hippocampal neuronal injury in the SCI-induced depression model. ICM alleviated neuroinflammatory responses by directly preventing the nuclear-to-cytoplasmic translocation of HMGB1, a critical damage-associated molecular pattern released from injured neurons that triggers microglial activation and inflammatory cytokine expression. Bulk RNA-seq of hippocampal tissue from the Sham, SCI, and SCI + ICM groups revealed significant enrichment of Toll-like receptor and NF-kappaB signaling pathways following SCI, highlighting the HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kappaB axis as a central inflammatory mechanism. Consistent with the transcriptomic prediction, both ICM treatment and neuronal HMGB1 knockdown markedly inhibited TLR4-NF-kappaB signaling, reduced reactive-oxygen-species accumulation, and diminished pro-inflammatory cytokine production in microglia. Notably, the combination of ICM and siHMGB1 produced no additive effect, confirming neuronal HMGB1 as the upstream driver of TLR4-NF-kappaB-dependent neuroinflammation. SCI-induced release of hippocampal neuronal HMGB1 activates microglial TLR4-NF-kappaB signaling, driving neuroinflammation and contributing to depressive-like behaviors. Targeting HMGB1 nuclear translocation with ICM represents a promising therapeutic approach for depression following SCI.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，脊髓损伤（spinal cord injury, SCI）可导致慢性脑损伤，进而可能引发抑郁和认知缺陷。高迁移率族蛋白B1（high mobility group box-1, HMGB1）在中枢神经系统（central nervous system, CNS）疾病的发病机制中发挥关键作用，但SCI诱发抑郁的机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨HMGB1在SCI后抑郁样行为中的关键机制。建立SCI诱导抑郁的大鼠模型，以评估ICM对神经行为结局、小胶质细胞活化和神经元损伤的治疗效果。通过分子对接预测ICM与HMGB1之间的相互作用。海马RNA-seq分析了ICM响应的转录变化，鉴定差异表达基因（DEGs），并通过KEGG富集突出TLR4-NF-kappaB信号通路，随后用Western blot验证选定靶点。在体内实验中，采用免疫荧光、Western blotting、qRT-PCR和ELISA评估海马中HMGB1转位、TLR4-NF-kappaB通路激活及炎症细胞因子产生。在体外实验中，使用小胶质细胞-神经元共培养系统研究神经元HMGB1在小胶质细胞介导的神经炎症中的作用，通过ICM预处理或siRNA敲低抑制HMGB1。我们的研究结果表明，inflachromene（ICM）有效抑制小胶质细胞活化，从而减少SCI诱导抑郁模型中的海马神经元损伤。ICM通过直接阻止HMGB1从细胞核向细胞质的转位来减轻神经炎症反应，HMGB1是一种从受损神经元释放的关键损伤相关分子模式，可触发小胶质细胞活化和炎症细胞因子表达。对Sham、SCI和SCI + ICM组海马组织的批量RNA-seq分析显示，SCI后Toll样受体和NF-kappaB信号通路显著富集，突出HMGB1-TLR4-NF-kappaB轴作为核心炎症机制。与转录组预测一致，ICM治疗和神经元HMGB1敲低均显著抑制TLR4-NF-kappaB信号传导，减少活性氧积累，并降低小胶质细胞中促炎细胞因子的产生。值得注意的是，ICM和siHMGB1的组合未产生叠加效应，证实神经元HMGB1是TLR4-NF-kappaB依赖性神经炎症的上游驱动因素。SCI诱导的海马神经元HMGB1释放激活小胶质细胞TLR4-NF-kappaB信号传导，驱动神经炎症并促成抑郁样行为。以ICM靶向HMGB1核转位代表了一种治疗SCI后抑郁的有前景的策略。
